name: biocartoon
description: BioCartoon skills: search about 20,000 open-licensed scientific illustrations, preview and download them with their credit lines, and draw and submit new ones to the shared library.

interface.longDescription: Search the BioCartoon library of open-licensed biology illustrations, download them with their credit lines, and draw and submit new ones.
defaultPrompt: Find an illustration of a pyramidal neuron for my figure.
Draw a BioCartoon-style icon of a ribosome and submit it.
Which CC0 icons of mitochondria are there?
